raw_posts.name: Beam.win
raw_posts.tagline: Run AI agents on one Mac and use its windows on another
raw_posts.description: Keep your agents and builds running on a Mac mini or Studio. Beam brings their Terminal, browser and other app windows onto the Mac in front of you, each as its own window with a Dock icon and ⌘Tab presence. Encrypted between your Macs. Free to try.

raw_posts.name: Figma Specs
raw_posts.tagline: A container for your context that lives on the Figma canvas
raw_posts.description: Figma Specs is a collaborative Markdown document that can live on its own or beside your designs. Embed Figma frames and FigJam diagrams, work through comments with teammates and agents, and pass the full context to coding agents through MCP.

raw_posts.name: readywhen
raw_posts.tagline: The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp
raw_posts.description: readywhen is the senior Personal Assistant that works inside WhatsApp. It has its own phone number, its own computer, and a project board that keeps track of everything on your plate. Call it. Message it. Voice-note it. And it gets real work done.

raw_posts.name: walkai-talkai
raw_posts.tagline: Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie
raw_posts.description: Press PTT on any handheld radio and talk to your AI coding agent, hands-free. walkai-talkai transcribes your voice on your Mac with local Whisper, types the command into Cursor, Claude Code or Antigravity (or calls OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama directly), then speaks the answer back over the radio with neural voice, VOX tones and a roger beep. Your radio audio never leaves your Mac. macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. One-time lifetime license, no subscription.

raw_posts.name: Kai Resolve by Gleap
raw_posts.tagline: Support that does the digging for you.
raw_posts.description: Kai Resolve is the AI agent for support tickets your docs can't answer. It reads the screen recording, logs, account data and your code, read-only, then answers the customer or escalates with a diagnosis. Confirmed bugs become coding tasks your team reviews.

raw_posts.name: Wally by Willow
raw_posts.tagline: Your Scribe agent that learns how you write
raw_posts.description: Meet Wally, your new Scribe agent in Willow. Chat by voice to draft an email/slack/ prompt, rewrite highlighted text and keep refining it in the same conversation. Wally uses your personal context and learns your writing style as you go back and forth.

raw_posts.name: Beam
raw_posts.tagline: Highly efficient agentic 501B parameter open model
raw_posts.description: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters, 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

raw_posts.name: buddylist
raw_posts.tagline: Chat with your coding agents like it's 2005
raw_posts.description: A free desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows and Linux that puts Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode in an MSN-style buddy list. Use separate Git worktrees for separate jobs, or group-chat agents in a shared folder. Let them take turns, answer together or hand unfinished tasks to another agent. Review diffs, run terminals, preview your app and track PR checks beside the chat. Bring your own agent accounts; provider access and usage are separate.

raw_posts.name: Framefields
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source code-first video for AGI era
raw_posts.description: Framefields is a high-performance, code-first video engine powered by native WebGPU in Node.js. Built for AI agents and engineers, it replaces bulky creative suites with a single npm package: motion graphics, Photoshop-grade VFX, 3D scenes, and audio DSP. Zero Chromium or browser overhead—render deterministic, frame-accurate video and export hardware-accelerated MP4s directly from TypeScript.
